I've added `GET /api/admin/users/recently-created`, which is restricted to admins and returns the logins of users created in the last 7 days, newest first. I haven't built or tested anything, as you asked.

- **Repository:** `UserRepository.findLoginsByCreatedDateAfter(Instant since)` is a JPQL query that selects only the logins.
- **Service:** `UserService.getRecentlyCreatedUserLogins()` works out the cutoff as `Instant.now(clock)` minus 7 days and calls the repository.
- **Endpoint:** `UserResource.getRecentlyCreatedUsers()` uses the same `@PreAuthorize` admin check as the other admin endpoints. It sits before `/users/{login}`, and Spring picks the literal path over the `{login}` pattern.
- **Clock:** `src/main/java/CLAUDE.md` says to inject a `Clock` and use `now(clock)`. The project had no `Clock` bean, so I added `ClockConfiguration`, which returns `Clock.systemUTC()`. `UserService` now takes a `Clock` as a new constructor argument.

I found no `new UserService(...)` call anywhere in `src`, so no existing test construction should break. I didn't add a test for the new endpoint.

The notes update from your `dev_private` instructions hasn't been done. There is no `notes/` folder in this project yet.
